name: gpmp_gravity_trap
description: Twin GPMP (gravity-pump) walls squeezing a hot-VOID 'reaction well' between them -- a gravitational fusion-confinement alternative to magnetic (FRAY/CONV) or electrostatic (DMND cage) designs.
why: 1732752 ('Infinite fushion reactor') confines its fusion 'star' with two facing GPMP walls (x202-217 and x425-440, spanning y71-309) pulling fuel toward the centerline, where a VOID region (247,116)-(395,264) held at ~9700C deletes whatever reaches it -- a cheap 'fusion consumes the fuel here' abstraction rather than simulated fusion byproducts. No existing module models confinement this way (deut_cell_mk2 and dmnd_throat both use portal/CLNE-based designs); this is mechanically simpler (two walls + a disposal-well core) and is flagged in the mechanisms doc as a good 'cheap fusion' option for FSN-3.
source: save 1732752, GPMP walls x202-217/425-440 y71-309 (3096 GPMP particles total); VOID well (247,116)-(395,264) Tavg=9694C
